title: Evil Genius
notes: Vault reads your saved games (DynamicResources\Layouts in the game folder) and never touches the game. Achievements pop when you save.
The tutorial base does not count. Every save you have counts, so older saves unlock what they show.

testGuide.title: Save on your island
testGuide.detail: Start a new game, build a little and save. "Welcome to the Island" should pop, and "Most cash in a save" should show your money.
